title: Integration Viewpoint Using UHPLC-MS/MS, In Silico Analysis, Network Pharmacology, and In Vitro Analysis to Evaluate the Bio-Potential of Muscari armeniacum Extracts.
authors: Nilofar, Nilofar; Zengin, Gokhan; Cetiz, Mehmet Veysi; Yildiztugay, Evren; Cziaky, Zoltan; Jeko, Jozsef; Ferrante, Claudio; Kostka, Tina; Esatbeyoglu, Tuba; Dall'Acqua, Stefano
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物的化学成分、抗氧化及酶抑制活性，仅附带少量分子对接和TF网络分析，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: The current study investigates the chemical profiling, antioxidant activities, and enzyme inhibitory and cytotoxic potential of the water and methanolic extracts of different parts (flower, leaf, and bulb) of Muscari armeniacum. Chemical profiling was performed using UHPLC-MS/MS. At the same time, different in vitro assays were employed to support the results for antioxidant potential, such as DPPH, ABTS, FRAP, CUPRAC, metal chelation, and PBD, along with the measurement of total phenolic and flavonoid contents. Enzyme inhibition was investigated for cholinesterase (AChE and BChE), alpha-amylase, alpha-glucosidase, and tyrosinase enzymes. Additionally, the relative expression of NRF2, HMOX1, and YGS was evaluated by qPCR. LC-MS/MS analysis indicated the presence of some significant compounds, including apigenin, muscaroside, hyacinthacine A, B, and C, and luteolin. According to the results, the highest TPC and TFC were obtained with both extracts of the leaves, followed by the water extract (flower) and methanolic extract of the bulb. In contrast, the methanolic extract from the bulb exhibited the highest antioxidant potential using DPPH, ABTS, CUPRAC, and FRAP, followed by the extracts of leaves. In contrast, the leaf extracts had the highest values for the PBD assay and maximum chelation ability compared to other tested extracts. According to the enzyme inhibition studies, the methanolic extract from the bulb appeared to be the most potent inhibitor for all the tested enzymes, with the highest values obtained for AChE (1.96 +/- 0.05), BChE (2.19 +/- 0.33), alpha-amylase (0.56 +/- 0.02), alpha-glucosidase (2.32 +/- 0.01), and tyrosinase (57.19 +/- 0.87). Interestingly, the water extract from the bulb did not inhibit most of the tested enzymes. The relative expression of NRF2 based on qPCR analysis was considerably greater in the flower methanol extract compared to the other extracts (p < 0.05). The relative expression of HMOX1 was stable in all the extracts, whereas YGS expression remained stable in all the treatments and had no statistical differences. The current results indicate that the components of M. armeniacum (leaves, flowers, and bulb) may be a useful source of natural bioactive compounds that are effective against oxidative stress-related conditions, including hyperglycemia, skin disorders, and neurodegenerative diseases. Complementary in silico approaches, including molecular docking, dynamics simulations, and transcription factor (TF) network analysis for NFE2L2, supported the experimental findings and suggested possible multi-target interactions for the selected compounds.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了 Muscari armeniacum 不同部位（花、叶、鳞茎）的水提物和甲醇提物的化学成分分析、抗氧化活性、酶抑制及细胞毒性潜力。采用 UHPLC-MS/MS 进行化学成分分析，同时运用多种体外实验（如 DPPH、ABTS、FRAP、CUPRAC、金属螯合和 PBD）支持抗氧化潜力结果，并测定总酚和总黄酮含量。酶抑制研究针对胆碱酯酶（AChE 和 BChE）、α-淀粉酶、α-葡萄糖苷酶和酪氨酸酶。此外，通过 qPCR 评估了 NRF2、HMOX1 和 YGS 的相对表达量。LC-MS/MS 分析表明存在一些重要化合物，包括芹菜素 (apigenin)、muscaroside、风信子碱 A、B 和 C (hyacinthacine A, B, and C) 以及木犀草素 (luteolin)。结果显示，叶子的两种提取物获得了最高的总酚含量 (TPC) 和总黄酮含量 (TFC)，其次是花的水提物和鳞茎的甲醇提物。相比之下，鳞茎的甲醇提物在 DPPH、ABTS、CUPRAC 和 FRAP 实验中表现出最高的抗氧化潜力，其次是叶子的提取物。而叶子的提取物在 PBD 实验中具有最高值，并且与其他测试提取物相比具有最大的螯合能力。根据酶抑制研究，鳞茎的甲醇提物对所有测试酶均表现出最强的抑制作用，其中 AChE (1.96 ± 0.05)、BChE (2.19 ± 0.33)、α-淀粉酶 (0.56 ± 0.02)、α-葡萄糖苷酶 (2.32 ± 0.01) 和酪氨酸酶 (57.19 ± 0.87) 的抑制值最高。有趣的是，鳞茎的水提物对大多数测试酶没有抑制作用。基于 qPCR 分析，花甲醇提物中 NRF2 的相对表达量显著高于其他提取物 (p < 0.05)。HMOX1 的相对表达量在所有提取物中保持稳定，而 YGS 表达在所有处理中保持稳定且无统计学差异。当前结果表明，M. armeniacum 的组分（叶、花和鳞茎）可能是天然生物活性化合物的有用来源，对氧化应激相关疾病（包括高血糖、皮肤疾病和神经退行性疾病）具有潜在疗效。补充的计算机模拟方法，包括分子对接、动力学模拟和针对 NFE2L2 的转录因子 (TF) 网络分析，支持了实验发现，并提示所选化合物可能存在多靶点相互作用。
